name: managing-drg-optimization
description: Reviews MS-DRG assignment on one inpatient claim so the DRG is accurate and supported by provider documentation; DRG optimization here means correcting errors in both directions, never upcoding. Validates principal diagnosis selection under UHDDS and ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines Section II, secondary diagnoses and CC/MCC capture under Section III, CC exclusion list checks, MS-DRG Grouper V44 for FY 2027 discharges, POA and HAC impact, symptom codes as principal, sepsis coded to the provider's statement rather than Sepsis-2 or Sepsis-3 criteria, discharge and transfer rules, the 3-day payment window, procedure O.R. status and the inpatient order. Drafts non-leading CDI and clinical validation query candidates under the ACDIS/AHIMA 2026 compliant query guidelines. Use for DRG validation, DRG optimization review, CC/MCC capture, case mix index (CMI) accuracy, CDI second-level review or pre-bill audit. Declines adding unsupported diagnoses or leading providers. Drafts for coder, CDI and compliance review.
